verdict.rationale: RUN documents electronic new-hire paperwork: employees complete personal info, direct deposit and Form W-4 before day one, and Form I-9 is completed electronically during onboarding. That covers a thin slice of the story, digital completion of standard HR forms. Nothing in the evidence mentions sending offer letters, e-signature of custom HR documents, or a per-employee document store. missing for 10: offer-letter sending, explicit e-signature capability for arbitrary HR documents, per-employee document storage/retrieval, independent or hands-on corroboration.
